attributes.Face Attributes: Gender, age groups , glasses, expressions , face mask, beard
attributes.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 face images in total. Name, gender, birthday, address, certificate type, cerificate No., countries®ions and state can be added to each face picture
attributes.SMD Plus by Recorder: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle SMD Plus, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change
attributes.Analog Camera Input: 32 BNC ports, CVI access by default, supports HDCVI/AHD/TVI/CVBS auto-detect
attributes.IP Camera Input: Up to 32 channels of IPC access 32 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 128 Mbps
attributes.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: All channel 5M-N@(1fps–10fps); 4M-N/1080P@(1fps–15fps); 1080N; 720P; 960H; D1; CIF@(1fps–25/30fps) Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1fps–25/30fps)
attributes.Video Frame Rate: PAL: 1 fps–25 fps. NTSC: 1 fps–30 fps
attributes.Video Output: 1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 TV HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable.
attributes.Third-party Camera Access: Onvif, RTSP, Panasonic, Sony, Axis, Arecont, Pelco, Canon, Samsung
attributes.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP / IP; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; P2P
attributes.Record Mode: General, motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
attributes.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback (face and motion detection)
attributes.Anomaly Alarm: No disk, storage error, low space, offline, IP conflict, MAC conflict
attributes.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection, face recognition, perimeter protection
attributes.Alarm Linkage: Record, snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, access controller, voice prompt, buzzer, log, preset, email
attributes.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
attributes.HDD Interface: 2 SATA ports, up to 16 TB, the maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
